method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: The intact closed container and designated pouch make clean paperwork separation the relevant correction; outer copies/double bags do not establish that separation.
The client is stable, PPE unavailable and cleanup being arranged, so immediate route restriction controls exposure and slips while help arrives.
Prompt soap-and-water removal of visible blood precedes source-status review or occupational advice; subsequent inspection determines the actual exposure pathway.
Dampness and expired dating policy require replacement; expected process indicator, appropriate contents and intact dry barrier do not themselves require discard.
An actual missing newborn band requires documented parent–infant matching and the approved replacement checks, not location or recognition.
Shared names and procedures make open-ended identifiers matched with the order meaningful; timing and yes/no confirmation can misidentify.
An unresolved site discrepancy needs reconciled records and repeated shared verification; verbal authority or an unreconciled booking list cannot resolve it.
A prescribed texture mismatch needs a matching replacement; cutting smaller, adding thickened fluid or judging softness do not reliably meet that texture.
Mismatch in a multiline setting makes route tracing, compatible enteral components and prescription verification appropriate; improvised adapters defeat route protection.
Transfer ability and locked brakes are supplied, isolating the remaining footplate obstacle; proper foot placement is the next preparation.
Observed slipping and worn tips require repair or checked replacement before use; distance, closer assistance and improvised tape do not restore validated traction.
New weakness means baseline independence is insufficient; appropriate exit height and current transfer assessment address the actual change.
An available dry alternative provides more reliable immediate control than warning, footwear or slow passage over the known wet route.
Calm purposeful walking without danger does not justify restraint or agitation medication; nursing assessment and staffing alternatives address the actual circumstances.
Timed retrieval, demonstrated connection and maintained charging/access ownership provide functional evidence; sent information and a future agenda do not.
New lift dependence requires updating the emergency-specific assistance/equipment plan; routine charting or one-shift communication can leave responders with obsolete directions.
Individual use or the actual device validated shared-use process addresses blood contamination; head-only, rinse-only and casing-only processes cannot be assumed sufficient.
Visible clothing contamination before another client requires changing and cleaning exposed skin; spot treatment, covering or finishing rounds leaves contamination in use.
Permitted planned walking with containment supports the selected preparations; a different recreation group is not automatically covered by that permission.
Entry into normally sterile tissue requires sterilization; foundation metadata correctly reflects processing-classification recall.
Readable instructions are already insufficient, making demonstration plus observed client practice the direct response to the identified independent-use skill gap.
Observed correct performance establishes practical competence with the new model more directly than attendance, acknowledgement or speed.

methodNote: Read every complete changed item from the immutable current snapshot; assessed stem, options, key, every rationale and metadata. No new primary retrieval in this followup; previously documented CDC vascular/glucose and PHAC routine-practice checks inform relevant cases.
